2.2.evidence:
If, after the risk assessment, they establish an immediate danger of domestic violence, the competent police officer issues an order imposing an emergency measure on the perpetrator who has been brought to the competent organizational unit of the police (Article 15, paragraph 1).
Emergency measures are: a measure of temporary removal of the perpetrator from the dwelling and a measure of temporary prohibition for the perpetrator to contact and approach the victim of violence.
The order contains: the name of the authority issuing it, data about the person to whom the emergency measure is imposed, the type of emergency measure being imposed and its duration, the day and hour of imposition of the emergency measure, and the obligation of the person to whom the emergency measure has been imposed to report to the police officer who imposed it upon its expiration.
A person who violates an urgent measure imposed or extended on them shall be punished by imprisonment of up to 60 days for a misdemeanour.
2.2.rationale: The text specifies an emergency measure order issued by a competent police officer upon finding immediate danger, defines the types of measures (removal from dwelling; prohibition of contact/approach), requires the order to include its duration, and provides a consequence for breach (punished by imprisonment up to 60 days for a misdemeanour). These elements meet the substantive coding requirements for a protection/restraining order mechanism.
